scanNote:
4-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (31-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'Days to Remember' va TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '4'.

CHAP USTUN:
25) 'GAME: What was Tim doing? Choose one of the places in the list and decide what Tim was doing there. In teams, the class asks questions to find out what Tim was doing there. The one who guesses correctly becomes the new leader.' Ro'yxat qiya harflarda: kitchen, library, pool, bathroom, dining room, garden, living room, hall, bedroom, study, balcony, garage. Ostida ko'k qiya namuna dialog (L - leader, Team A S1, Team B S1).
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq "Communication: A Witness' Report" sarlavhasi.
26) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Put the verbs in the past simple or past continuous, then listen and check. In pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts.' A va B (Mr Jeffries) dialogi, olti bo'shliq. Ostida ikkita nuqtali ko'rsatma.
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game' sarlavhasi.
27) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' 11 ta ibora qiya harflarda.
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation' sarlavhasi.
28) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and underline the stressed word, then tick the correct meaning. Listen again and repeat.' Beshta gap, har birida ikkita ma'no va katakcha. 1-gapda 'six' TAGIGA ChIZILGAN va ikkinchi ma'no BELGILANGAN (namuna).

O'NG USTUN:
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' sarlavhasi va qora yozuv '(a story)'.
• To'q sariq ramkali quti - hikoya yozish qoidasi (qalin harflar bilan ajratilgan iboralar).
29) (kassetа belgisi bilan) 'Listen and put the events in the correct order. Then, use the list to retell the story.' Yettita gap; ikkitasiga ALLAQAChON raqam qo'yilgan (1 va 5). O'ngda dumaloq rasmda ko'k-to'q sariq QIRG'OVUL (kingfisher) qushi.
30) 'Use the list of events in Ex. 29, the pictures in the Photo File section, and the plan below, to write a story entitled The Waterfall for your teacher (120 - 180 words).'
• Spiralli daftar shaklidagi ramkada REJA: Plan - Introduction (Para 1), Main Body (Paras 2-3), Conclusion (Para 4).
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom' sarlavhasi: 'Read these sentences. What do they mean?' Ramkada ikkita maqol: 'One story is good till another is told.' va 'A tale never loses in the telling.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '31'.

exercises.instructionEn: GAME: What was Tim doing? Choose one of the places in the list and decide what Tim was doing there. In teams, the class asks questions to find out what Tim was doing there. The one who guesses correctly becomes the new leader.
exercises.instructionUz: O'YIN: Tim nima qilayotgan edi? Ro'yxatdagi joylardan birini tanlang va Tim u yerda nima qilayotganini o'ylab toping. Guruhlarga bo'linib, sinf Tim u yerda nima qilayotganini bilish uchun savol beradi. To'g'ri topgan odam yangi boshlovchi bo'ladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
PAST CONTINUOUS BILAN TOPISh O'YINI.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  L: Tim was in the kitchen at 3 o'clock
     yesterday. What was he doing there?
  Team A S1: Was he cooking?
  L: No, he wasn't.
  Team B S1: Was he eating?
  L: Yes, he was.

  ⚠ 'L' = Leader (boshlovchi).


JOYLAR RO'YXATI:

  kitchen     - oshxona
  library     - kutubxona
  pool        - basseyn
  bathroom    - hammom
  dining room - ovqat xonasi
  garden      - bog'
  living room - mehmonxona
  hall        - dahliz
  bedroom     - yotoqxona
  study       - kabinet
  balcony     - balkon
  garage      - garaj

  ⚠ 'a study' = ish xonasi, kabinet
  (o'qish - 'studying').
  ⚠ 'a hall' = dahliz; katta zal.


⚠ SAVOL VA QISQA JAVOB:

  'WAS he cooking?'
     - 'Yes, he WAS.' / "No, he WASN'T."

  ⚠ SO'ROQDA 'was' EGADAN OLDIN.
  ⚠ Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l
  TAKRORLANMAYDI.


⚠ HAR JOYDA NIMA QILISh MUMKIN:

  kitchen - cooking, washing up, eating
  library - reading, studying, borrowing
     a book
  pool - swimming, diving
  bathroom - having a shower, brushing
     teeth
  dining room - having dinner
  garden - watering flowers, cutting
     the grass
  living room - watching TV, relaxing
  bedroom - sleeping, getting dressed
  study - working, writing
  balcony - sunbathing, watering plants
  garage - repairing the car

items.prompt: Tim kecha soat 3 da oshxonada edi. U u yerda nima qilayotgan edi?
items.question: Tim was in the kitchen at 3 o'clock yesterday. What was he doing there?
items.answer: Was he cooking? - No, he wasn't.
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ SO'ROQDA 'was' EGADAN OLDIN turadi.

items.question: Was he eating?
items.whyUz:
Kitobdagi NAMUNA.

⚠ Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l TAKRORLANMAYDI.
⚠ Tasdiqda qisqartma IShLATILMAYDI.

items.question: Was he watering the flowers?
items.answer: No, he wasn't. He was cutting the grass.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 29-betdagi 19-mashqda bu ishlar bor edi.
⚠ 'to water the flowers', 'to cut the grass'.

items.question: Was he repairing his car?
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'to repair' = tuzatmoq ('to fix' bilan bir xil).
⚠ 10-betdagi 24-mashqda 'fixes cars' bor edi.

items.question: Was he reading a book?
items.answer: No, he wasn't. He was studying for an exam.
items.whyUz:
⚠ 'a library' = kutubxona; 'a bookshop' =
kitob do'koni (18-bet) - ADAShTIRMANG.
⚠ 'to study FOR an exam' - predlog 'for'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in the past simple or past continuous, then listen and check. In pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts.
exercises.instructionUz: Fe'llarni past simple yoki past continuous shakliga qo'ying, so'ng tinglang va tekshiring. Juftlikda ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
GUVOHNING KO'RSATUVI.

  ⚠ Politsiya guvohdan so'raydi:
  nima bo'ldi, qayerda eding, nima
  qilayotgan eding.

  ⚠ Bu - 8-betdagi modul rejasida
  aytilgan mavzu: 'report events
  (as a witness)'.


⚠ QAYSI ZAMON QAYERDA:

  PAST SIMPLE - bo'lib o'tgan VOQEA:
     1 happened - nima sodir bo'ldi
     2 was - qanday voqea edi
     3 were you - qayerda eding
     4 was - qayerda edim

  PAST CONTINUOUS - o'sha paytda DAVOM
  ETAYoTGAN ish:
     5 were you doing - nima
        qilayotgan eding
     6 was cutting - o'rayotgan edim


⚠ 3 va 5-SAVOLLARNING FARQI:

  'Where WERE you at the time?'
     = qayerda eding? (HOLAT → simple)
  'What WERE you DOING?'
     = nima qilayotgan eding?
       (ISh → continuous)

  ⚠ 'be' fe'li CONTINUOUS shaklda
  ishlatilmaydi, shuning uchun
  3-bandda faqat 'were'.


⚠ 'AT THE TIME':

  = o'sha paytda.
  ⚠ 'at that time' bilan bir xil.


⚠ 'EXACTLY':

  'What EXACTLY happened?'
  = aynan nima bo'ldi?
  ⚠ Savolni ANIQROQ qiladi -
  25-betdagi 4-mashqda ham bor edi.


⚠ 'A ROBBERY' va 'A BURGLARY':

  a robbery = qaroqchilik (odamdan
     yoki bankdan, KUCh bilan)
  a burglary = o'g'irlik (uyga
     tunab kirish)

  ⚠ Ko'rsatmalarda ikkalasi ham bor.
  ⚠ 'a robber' - 27-betdagi 7-mashqda
  bor edi.


⚠ 'A NEIGHBOURHOOD':

  = mahalla, atrof.
  ⚠ Britaniyada 'neighbourhood',
  AQShda 'neighborhood'.


KO'RSATMALAR (yangi dialoglar uchun):

  • a burglary next door - in my bedroom
    - sleep
  • a robbery at the bank - outside the
    bank - talk to the security guard

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada UCh qism:
     nima bo'ldi - qayerda eding -
     nima qilayotgan eding

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: So, Mr Jeffries, what exactly 1) ___ (happen) yesterday?
lines.uz: Xo'sh, janob Jeffris, kecha aynan nima sodir bo'ldi?
lines.whyUz:
⚠ Bo'lib o'tgan VOQEA → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ 'to happen' - TO'G'RI fe'l: happened.
⚠ 'exactly' savolni aniqroq qiladi.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: There 2) ___ (be) a robbery in my neighbourhood.
lines.whyUz:
⚠ 'There WAS ...' - o'tgan zamonda 'there is'.
⚠ 'be' - HOLAT fe'li, CONTINUOUS BO'LMAYDI.
⚠ 'a robbery' = qaroqchilik.

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ HOLAT → PAST SIMPLE.
⚠ SO'ROQDA 'were' EGADAN OLDIN.
⚠ 'at the time' = o'sha paytda.

lines.speaker: A
lines.whyUz:
⚠ O'sha paytda DAVOM ETAYoTGAN ish →
PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 3-savol bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda HOLAT
(were), bu yerda ISh (were doing).

lines.speaker: B
lines.whyUz:
⚠ DAVOM ETAYoTGAN ish → PAST CONTINUOUS.
⚠ 'cut' - qisqa unli + bitta undosh →
'cutTING' (undosh IKKILANADI).
⚠ 29-betdagi 19-mashqda 'cutting the grass'
bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: In pairs, act out similar dialogues using the prompts.
exercises.instructionUz: Juftlikda ko'rsatmalar bilan shunga o'xshash dialoglarni ijro eting.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI YaNGI DIALOG.

  ⚠ Har ko'rsatmada UCh qism:
     1) nima bo'ldi
     2) qayerda eding
     3) nima qilayotgan eding


⚠ 'A BURGLARY NEXT DOOR':

  = qo'shni uyda o'g'irlik.
  ⚠ 'next door' = qo'shni uy(da).
  ⚠ 'a burglar' = uyga tunab kiruvchi
  o'g'ri.


⚠ 'A SECURITY GUARD':

  = qo'riqchi.
  ⚠ 21-betdagi Harrods matnida
  'security personnel' bor edi.

points.en: A: So, what exactly happened yesterday? B: There was a burglary next door. A: Where were you at the time? B: I was in my bedroom. A: What were you doing? B: I was sleeping.
points.uz: A: Xo'sh, kecha aynan nima sodir bo'ldi? B: Qo'shni uyda o'g'irlik bo'ldi. A: O'sha paytda qayerda edingiz? B: Yotoqxonamda edim. A: Nima qilayotgan edingiz? B: Uxlayotgan edim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a burglary' = uyga tunab kirib o'g'irlash.
⚠ 'next door' = qo'shni uy(da).
⚠ 'was sleeping' - PAST CONTINUOUS.

points.en: A: So, what exactly happened yesterday? B: There was a robbery at the bank. A: Where were you at the time? B: I was outside the bank. A: What were you doing? B: I was talking to the security guard.
points.uz: A: Xo'sh, kecha aynan nima sodir bo'ldi? B: Bankda qaroqchilik bo'ldi. A: O'sha paytda qayerda edingiz? B: Bank oldida edim. A: Nima qilayotgan edingiz? B: Qo'riqchi bilan gaplashayotgan edim.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'outside' - PREDLOGSIZ: 'outside the bank'.
⚠ 'to talk TO sb' - predlog 'to'.
⚠ 'a security guard' = qo'riqchi.

exercises.instructionEn: In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.
exercises.instructionUz: Guruhlarga bo'linib, quyidagi so'z va iboralar bilan gap tuzing. Har bir to'g'ri gap uchun bir ochko.
exercises.explanationUz:
4-UNITNING BUTUN LUG'ATI.

  ⚠ 11 ta ibora - hammasi 26-30-betlarda
  uchragan.

  ⚠ Ko'pchiligi 27-betdagi 'The Wedding
  Anniversary' va 30-betdagi 'Up, Up
  and Away!' hikoyalaridan.


⚠ QIYIN IBORALAR:

  no longer alive - endi tirik emas
  had in mind - ko'zda tutgan edi
  was hanging from - ilinib turgan edi
  radioed for help - radio orqali
     yordam so'ragan


⚠ 'TO RISE' - O'TIMSIZ:

  ⚠ 'to raise' (o'timli) bilan
  ADAShTIRMANG.
  ⚠ rise - rose - risen.

modelSentences.sentence: She phoned the taxi service again to cancel the call.
modelSentences.uz: U chaqiruvni bekor qilish uchun taksi xizmatiga yana qo'ng'iroq qildi.

modelSentences.sentence: There was something familiar about the young woman.
modelSentences.uz: Yosh ayolda tanish nimadir bor edi.

modelSentences.sentence: His grandparents were no longer alive.
modelSentences.uz: Uning buvi-bobosi endi tirik emas edi.

modelSentences.sentence: The old clock was ticking loudly in the guest room.
modelSentences.uz: Eski soat mehmonxonada qattiq chiqillayotgan edi.

modelSentences.sentence: Bob picked her up in his car at ten o'clock.
modelSentences.uz: Bob uni soat o'nda mashinasida olib ketdi.

modelSentences.sentence: The balloon shook violently from side to side.
modelSentences.uz: Shar u yoqdan-bu yoqqa qattiq silkindi.

modelSentences.sentence: Bob radioed for help as soon as the balloon landed.
modelSentences.uz: Shar qo'nishi bilanoq Bob radio orqali yordam so'radi.

modelSentences.sentence: The basket was hanging from a branch.
It wasn't quite what I had in mind.
modelSentences.uz: Bu men ko'zda tutgan narsa emas edi.

modelSentences.sentence: The balloon began to rise slowly into the air.
He went into the room and turned on the light.
modelSentences.uz: U xonaga kirdi va chiroqni yoqdi.

exercises.audioRequiredUz: Qaysi so'z URG'U bilan aytilishi FAQAT audioda eshitiladi - shuning uchun to'g'ri ma'noni ham yozuvsiz tanlab bo'lmaydi.
exercises.instructionEn: Listen and underline the stressed word, then tick the correct meaning. Listen again and repeat.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va urg'uli so'z tagiga chizing, so'ng to'g'ri ma'noni belgilang. Yana tinglang va takrorlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
GAP URG'USI MA'NONI O'ZGARTIRADI.

  ⚠ Bu unitning talaffuz mavzusi -
  3-betdagi mundarijada 'Pronunciation:
  sentence stress' deb yozilgan edi.


⚠ ASOSIY G'OYA:

  Bir xil gap, lekin BOShQA so'zga
  urg'u tushsa - MA'NO O'ZGARADI.

  ⚠ Bu - o'zbek tilida ham bor, lekin
  ingliz tilida ancha kuchliroq.


KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:

  'I was here at SIX o'clock.'
     (urg'u 'six' da)
  → 'not at seven o'clock'
     (BELGILANGAN)

  ⚠ Agar urg'u 'here' da bo'lsa:
  'I was HERE at six o'clock.'
  → 'not somewhere else'


QOLGAN GAPLAR (urg'u AUDIODAN):

  * ⚠ 2  'A young woman was standing at
    the door.'
       urg'u 'young' da → not an old
          woman
       urg'u 'woman' da → not a young man

  * ⚠ 3  'They were both very sad.'
       urg'u 'both' da → not just one
          of them
       urg'u 'sad' da → they weren't
          happy

  * ⚠ 4  'He was cooking in the kitchen.'
       urg'u 'cooking' da → he wasn't
          eating
       urg'u 'kitchen' da → not in the
          bedroom

  * ⚠ 5  'This is my grandmother.'
       urg'u 'my' da → not someone
          else's
       urg'u 'grandmother' da → not my
          mother


⚠ QOIDA:

  URG'U TUShGAN SO'Z - AYNAN ShU
  narsa muhim ekanini bildiradi va
  QARAMA-QARShI variantni rad etadi.

  ⚠ 'I was here at SIX' → vaqt muhim
  ⚠ 'I was HERE at six' → joy muhim


⚠ 'STRESS' - IKKI XIL:

  word stress - SO'Z ichidagi urg'u
     ('PHOtograph' - 'phoTOgrapher')
  sentence stress - GAP ichidagi urg'u
     (bu mashqning mavzusi)

  ⚠ 9-unitning talaffuz mavzusi -
  'word stress'.

points.en: 1  I was here at SIX o'clock. → not at seven o'clock
points.uz: 1  Men bu yerda soat OLTIDA edim. → yettida emas
points.noteUz:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN (namuna): 'six' tagiga
chizilgan va ikkinchi ma'no belgilangan.

⚠ Agar urg'u 'HERE' da bo'lsa - ma'no
'boshqa joyda emas' bo'lardi.

points.en: 2  A young woman was standing at the door. → ⚠ the stressed word is only heard on the recording
points.uz: 2  Eshik oldida yosh ayol turgan edi. → ⚠ urg'uli so'z faqat audioda
points.noteUz:
⚠ Urg'u 'YOUNG' da → 'not an old woman'.
⚠ Urg'u 'WOMAN' da → 'not a young man'.

⚠ Qaysi biri - AUDIODAN.

points.en: 3  They were both very sad. → ⚠ the stressed word is only heard on the recording
points.uz: 3  Ular ikkalasi ham juda g'amgin edi. → ⚠ urg'uli so'z faqat audioda
points.noteUz:
⚠ Urg'u 'BOTH' da → 'not just one of them'.
⚠ Urg'u 'SAD' da → "they weren't happy".

⚠ Qaysi biri - AUDIODAN.

points.en: 4  He was cooking in the kitchen. → ⚠ the stressed word is only heard on the recording
points.uz: 4  U oshxonada ovqat pishirayotgan edi. → ⚠ urg'uli so'z faqat audioda
points.noteUz:
⚠ Urg'u 'COOKING' da → "he wasn't eating".
⚠ Urg'u 'KITCHEN' da → 'not in the bedroom'.

⚠ Qaysi biri - AUDIODAN.

points.en: 5  This is my grandmother. → ⚠ the stressed word is only heard on the recording
points.uz: 5  Bu mening buvim. → ⚠ urg'uli so'z faqat audioda
points.noteUz:
⚠ Urg'u 'MY' da → "not someone else's".
⚠ Urg'u 'GRANDMOTHER' da → 'not my mother'.

⚠ Qaysi biri - AUDIODAN.

points.en: Rule: the stressed word shows what is important and rejects the opposite.
points.uz: Qoida: urg'uli so'z nima muhimligini ko'rsatadi va qarama-qarshi variantni rad etadi.
points.noteUz:
⚠ Bu - 'sentence stress' (gap urg'usi).
⚠ 'word stress' (so'z urg'usi) 9-unitda
o'rganiladi.

exercises.instructionEn: When we write a story, we first decide on a plot line (a series of events that lead up to the main event). We can divide our story into four paragraphs.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoya yozganda avval syujet chizig'ini (asosiy voqeaga olib boradigan voqealar zanjirini) belgilaymiz. Hikoyani to'rt xatboshiga bo'lish mumkin.
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI QUTI - HIKOYa YoZISh QOIDASI.


⚠ 'A PLOT LINE':

  = syujet chizig'i.
  ⚠ 'a plot' = syujet, voqealar zanjiri.
  ⚠ 'a series of events that LEAD UP TO
  the main event' = asosiy voqeaga
  OLIB BORADIGAN voqealar zanjiri.

  ⚠ Ya'ni avval REJA tuziladi, keyin
  yoziladi.


TO'RT XATBOShI:

  1-xatboshi:
     QAChON va QAYERDA bo'ldi
     KIM ishtirok etadi
     AVVAL nima bo'ldi

  2 va 3-xatboshilar:
     ASOSIY voqeadan OLDIN nima bo'ldi
     ASOSIY voqeaning O'ZI

  4-xatboshi (oxirgi):
     OXIR-OQIBAT nima bo'ldi
     odamlar o'zini QANDAY his qildi

  ⚠ Bu - 29-betdagi 'Beginnings -
  Endings' qutisining kengaytmasi.


⚠ VOQEALAR TARTIBI:

  'We usually write the events IN THE
   ORDER THEY HAPPENED.'
  = voqealarni SODIR BO'LGAN TARTIBDA
    yozamiz.

  ⚠ 29 va 23-mashqlar aynan shuni
  mashq qildiradi.


⚠ HIKOYaNI QIZIQARLI QILISh:

  1) ACTUAL WORDS (direct speech)
     = to'g'ri nutq, tirnoq ichida
     "'This is fantastic!' she
      shouted."

  2) A VARIETY OF ADJECTIVES
     = turli sifatlar
     huge, bright, worried, dark

  3) ADVERBS
     = ravishlar
     cheerfully, violently, anxiously,
     calmly

  ⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada uchalasi ham
  ko'p ishlatilgan.


⚠ ZAMONLAR:

  'We normally use the PAST SIMPLE and
   PAST CONTINUOUS in such pieces of
   writing.'

  ⚠ PAST SIMPLE - voqealar
  ⚠ PAST CONTINUOUS - fon va tasvir


⚠ 'A PIECE OF WRITING':

  = yozma ish.
  ⚠ 'writing' SANALMAYDIGAN, shuning
  uchun 'a piece of' kerak
  (13-betda 'a piece of music' bor edi).

points.en: When we write a story, we first decide on a plot line (a series of events that lead up to the main event).
points.uz: Hikoya yozganda avval syujet chizig'ini (asosiy voqeaga olib boradigan voqealar zanjirini) belgilaymiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'a plot' = syujet.
⚠ 'to lead up to sth' = ... ga olib bormoq.
⚠ Avval REJA, keyin yozish.

points.en: In the first paragraph we say when and where the story happened, who the people in the story are and what happened first.
points.uz: Birinchi xatboshida hikoya qachon va qayerda bo'lganini, ishtirokchilar kimligini va avval nima sodir bo'lganini aytamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ TO'RT savol - 29-betdagi quti bilan AYNI.
⚠ WHEN? WHERE? WHO? WHAT FIRST?

points.en: In the second and third paragraphs we write what happened before the main event, then describe the main event.
points.uz: Ikkinchi va uchinchi xatboshilarda asosiy voqeadan oldin nima bo'lganini yozamiz, so'ng asosiy voqeani tasvirlaymiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ ASOSIY voqea - hikoyaning cho'qqisi.
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada asosiy voqea - chaqmoq
va sharning daraxtga qo'nishi.

points.en: We usually write the events in the order they happened.
points.uz: Voqealarni odatda sodir bo'lgan tartibda yozamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 23 va 29-mashqlar aynan shuni mashq
qildiradi.
⚠ Ketma-ketlik so'zlari yordam beradi:
First, Then, After that, Finally.

points.en: In the last paragraph we describe what happened in the end and how the people felt.
points.uz: Oxirgi xatboshida oxir-oqibat nima bo'lgani va odamlar o'zini qanday his qilganini tasvirlaymiz.

points.en: We can use someone's actual words (direct speech) as well as a variety of adjectives and adverbs to make our story more interesting.
points.uz: Hikoyani qiziqarliroq qilish uchun to'g'ri nutq, turli sifat va ravishlardan foydalanish mumkin.
points.noteUz:
⚠ 'direct speech' = to'g'ri nutq (tirnoq ichida).
⚠ 30-betdagi hikoyada juda ko'p ravish bor:
cheerfully, violently, anxiously, calmly.

points.en: We normally use the past simple and past continuous in such pieces of writing.
points.uz: Bunday yozma ishlarda odatda past simple va past continuous ishlatamiz.
points.noteUz:
⚠ PAST SIMPLE - voqealar; PAST CONTINUOUS -
fon va tasvir.
⚠ 'a piece of writing' - 'writing'
SANALMAYDIGAN.

exercises.instructionEn: Listen and put the events in the correct order. Then, use the list to retell the story.
exercises.instructionUz: Tinglang va voqealarni to'g'ri tartibga qo'ying. So'ng ro'yxatdan foydalanib hikoyani qayta so'zlang.
exercises.explanationUz:
'THE WATERFALL' HIKOYaSINING VOQEALARI.

  ⚠ Kitobda IKKI raqam ALLAQAChON
  qo'yilgan: 1 (Mark & Dan got into
  the canoe) va 5 (They saw a
  waterfall).


TO'G'RI TARTIB:

  1  Mark & Dan got into the canoe.
     (BERILGAN)
  2  They saw a kingfisher.
  3  They stopped to have some coffee.
  4  They got back into the canoe.
  5  They saw a waterfall.  (BERILGAN)
  6  Two fishermen pulled the canoe to
     safety.
  7  They thanked the fishermen.


⚠ QANDAY TOPILADI:

  ⚠ 'They GOT BACK into the canoe' -
  'back' so'zi ular AVVAL chiqib
  ketganini bildiradi. Demak undan
  oldin 'They STOPPED to have some
  coffee' bo'lishi kerak.

  ⚠ 'They THANKED the fishermen' -
  baliqchilar YoRDAM BERGANDAN keyin.

  ⚠ 'a kingfisher' - qayiqda ketayotib
  ko'radigan narsa, sharsharadan
  OLDIN.


⚠ 'A KINGFISHER':

  = qirg'ovul, baliqchi qush.
  ⚠ 'king' (shoh) + 'fisher' (baliqchi).
  ⚠ Betdagi dumaloq rasmda aynan shu
  qush - ko'k va to'q sariq patli.


⚠ 'A WATERFALL':

  = sharshara.
  ⚠ 'water' + 'fall' - qo'shma ot.
  ⚠ 9-betdagi Susanning xatida ham
  bor edi.


⚠ 'TO PULL' va 'TO PUSH':

  to pull = tortmoq
  to push = itarmoq

  ⚠ 'pulled the canoe TO SAFETY' =
  qayiqni xavfsiz joyga tortdi.


⚠ 'TO THANK SB':

  ⚠ PREDLOGSIZ: 'thank the fishermen'.
  ⚠ Sabab uchun 'FOR': 'thank sb FOR
  sth'.


⚠ 'A FISHERMAN':

  ⚠ Ko'pligi 'fisherMEN'.
  ⚠ 7-betdagi Tailand matnida ham
  bor edi.

pairs.right: Mark & Dan got into the canoe.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ 'to get INTO a canoe/car' - kichik transport
uchun 'into'.

⚠ Qayiqda ketayotib ko'radigan narsa -
sharsharadan OLDIN.
⚠ 'a kingfisher' = 'king' + 'fisher'.

pairs.right: They stopped to have some coffee.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'to stop TO DO sth' = qilish uchun to'xtamoq.
⚠ 'to stop DOING sth' = qilishni to'xtatmoq -
BOShQA ma'no!

pairs.right: They got back into the canoe.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ 'BACK' so'zi ular AVVAL chiqib ketganini
bildiradi - demak 3-voqeadan KEYIN.

⚠ Kitobda BERILGAN.
⚠ Bu - hikoyaning ASOSIY voqeasi
(sarlavha ham shu: 'The Waterfall').

pairs.right: Two fishermen pulled the canoe to safety.
pairs.rightUz: Ikki baliqchi qayiqni xavfsiz joyga tortdi.
pairs.whyUz:
⚠ Xavfdan keyingi QUTQARISh.
⚠ 'a fisherman' → ko'plikda 'fisherMEN'.
⚠ 'to pull sth to safety' = xavfsiz joyga
tortmoq.

⚠ OXIRGI voqea - yordam BERILGANDAN keyin.
⚠ 'to thank sb' - PREDLOGSIZ.

exercises.instructionEn: Use the list of events in Ex. 29, the pictures in the Photo File section, and the plan below, to write a story entitled The Waterfall for your teacher (120 - 180 words).
exercises.instructionUz: 29-mashqdagi voqealar ro'yxati, Photo File bo'limidagi rasmlar va quyidagi rejadan foydalanib, o'qituvchingiz uchun 'The Waterfall' nomli hikoya yozing (120 - 180 so'z).
exercises.explanationUz:
KITOBDAGI REJA:

  INTRODUCTION
     Para 1: start the story
             (who, when, where, what)

  MAIN BODY
     Paras 2-3: develop the story
             (events before the main
              event, the main event
              itself)

  CONCLUSION
     Para 4: end the story
             (what happened in the end,
              how people felt)


⚠ HAJM: 120-180 SO'Z

  ⚠ Bu - 29-betdagi (100-150) va
  23-betdagi (100-150) topshiriqlardan
  KATTAROQ, chunki hikoya to'liq
  yoziladi.


⚠ 'ENTITLED':

  = ... deb nomlangan.
  ⚠ 'a title' (sarlavha) so'zidan
  (2-betda ham bor edi).


⚠ QANDAY YoZILADI:

  1) 29-mashqdagi yettita voqeani
     tartibga soling
  2) Har voqeani 2-3 gapga kengaytiring
  3) FON qo'shing (ob-havo, joy tasviri)
     - past continuous
  4) TO'G'RI NUTQ qo'shing
     ("..." he said)
  5) SIFAT va RAVISh qo'shing

  ⚠ Bu - 30-betdagi hikoyaning
  AYNAN usuli.


⚠ FOYDALI IBORALAR:

  It was a warm summer morning ...
  Suddenly, ...
  Before they could ...
  At that moment ...
  Fortunately, ...
  In the end, ...
  They felt very relieved.

structure.headingUz: 1-xatboshi (Kirish): kim, qachon, qayerda, avval nima bo'ldi
structure.modelEn: It was a warm summer morning and the sun was shining brightly. Mark and Dan, two old friends, were spending the weekend by the river. After breakfast, they got into their canoe and started rowing down the river.
structure.modelUz: Iliq yozgi tong edi va quyosh yorqin porlayotgan edi. Ikki eski do'st Mark va Den dam olish kunlarini daryo bo'yida o'tkazishayotgan edi. Nonushtadan keyin ular qayiqlariga o'tirishdi va daryo bo'ylab eshkak esha boshlashdi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ FON → past continuous ('was shining',
'were spending').
⚠ VOQEA → past simple ('got', 'started').
⚠ WHO, WHEN, WHERE, WHAT FIRST - to'rt savol.

structure.modelEn: As they were rowing, they saw a beautiful kingfisher sitting on a branch. "Look at that!" Mark shouted excitedly. An hour later they were feeling tired, so they stopped to have some coffee on the bank.
structure.modelUz: Eshkak eshayotganda ular shoxda o'tirgan chiroyli baliqchi qushni ko'rishdi. "Anavini qara!" - hayajon bilan qichqirdi Mark. Bir soatdan keyin ular charchaganini his qilishdi, shuning uchun qirg'oqda qahva ichish uchun to'xtashdi.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'As they WERE ROWING' + 'they SAW' -
17-mashqning 'c' qo'llanishi.
⚠ TO'G'RI NUTQ qo'shildi.
⚠ 'to stop TO DO sth' = qilish uchun to'xtamoq.

structure.modelEn: Soon they got back into the canoe. Suddenly, they heard a loud noise. Before they could do anything, they saw a huge waterfall in front of them. The canoe was moving faster and faster towards it. "We're going to fall!" screamed Dan.
structure.modelUz: Ko'p o'tmay ular yana qayiqqa o'tirishdi. To'satdan ular baland shovqin eshitishdi. Biror narsa qilishga ulgurmasidan oldilarida ulkan sharsharani ko'rishdi. Qayiq unga tomon tobora tezroq harakatlanardi. "Yiqilamiz!" - chinqirdi Den.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ ASOSIY voqea - hikoyaning cho'qqisi.
⚠ 'Suddenly' - burilish nuqtasi.
⚠ 'faster and faster' = tobora tezroq.
⚠ 'to scream' - 30-betdagi hikoyada ham bor edi.

structure.modelEn: Fortunately, two fishermen were standing on the bank. They threw a rope and pulled the canoe to safety just in time. Mark and Dan thanked them again and again. They felt very relieved and they will never forget that day.
structure.modelUz: Yaxshiyamki, qirg'oqda ikki baliqchi turgan edi. Ular arqon tashlashdi va qayiqni o'z vaqtida xavfsiz joyga tortishdi. Mark va Den ularga qayta-qayta rahmat aytishdi. Ular o'zlarini juda yengil his qilishdi va o'sha kunni hech qachon unutmaydilar.
structure.noteUz:
⚠ 'Fortunately' - 30-betdagi hikoyada ham
bor edi.
⚠ 'relieved' - 28-betdagi 9-mashqda.
⚠ Oxirgi gap UNIT NOMIGA ishora:
'Days to Remember'.

exercises.instructionEn: Read these sentences. What do they mean? - One story is good till another is told. A tale never loses in the telling.
exercises.instructionUz: Bu gaplarni o'qing. Ular nimani anglatadi? - Bir hikoya boshqasi aytilguncha yaxshi. Hikoya aytilgan sari kamaymaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IKKI MAQOL - IKKALASI HAM HIKOYa
HAQIDA.


1) 'ONE STORY IS GOOD TILL ANOTHER
   IS TOLD.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Bir hikoya boshqasi
  aytilguncha yaxshi'.

  MA'NOSI: Faqat bir tomonni eshitib
  hukm chiqarmang - ikkinchi tomonni
  ham eshiting.

  ⚠ Sud va nizolarda ko'p ishlatiladi.

  ⚠ 'till' = 'until' ning qisqa shakli
  (19-betdagi Parij matnida ham bor
  edi).
  ⚠ 'is told' - MAJHUL NISBAT
  (9-unit mavzusi).

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Bir tomonning gapiga
  quloq solma.'


2) 'A TALE NEVER LOSES IN THE TELLING.'

  So'zma-so'z: 'Hikoya aytilishida
  hech qachon yo'qotmaydi'.

  MA'NOSI: Hikoya har aytilganda
  KATTALAShIB boradi - odamlar
  tafsilotlarni qo'shib yuboradi.

  ⚠ Ya'ni eshitgan hikoyangizga
  butunlay ishonmang.

  ⚠ 'a tale' = hikoya, qissa
  (26-betda 'a fairy tale' bor edi).
  ⚠ 'in the telling' = aytilish
  jarayonida.

  ⚠ O'zbekchada: 'Og'izdan og'izga
  o'tib kattalashadi.'


⚠ NIMA UChUN BU MAQOLLAR ShU YERDA:

  Unit HIKOYa yozish va so'zlash
  haqida. Ikkala maqol ham hikoyaning
  ishonchliligi haqida - unit
  mavzusiga to'g'ri keladi.


⚠ 'A STORY' va 'A TALE':

  a story - hikoya (umumiy so'z)
  a tale - hikoya, qissa (ko'proq
     og'zaki, xalq ijodi)

  ⚠ 'a fairy tale' = ertak.
  ⚠ 'to tell a tale' - 'tell' bilan
  ('say' EMAS).

items.en: One story is good till another is told.
items.answerEn: It means that you should listen to both sides before you decide who is right.
items.answerUz: Bu shuni anglatadiki, kim haq ekanini hal qilishdan oldin ikkala tomonni ham eshitish kerak.

items.en: A tale never loses in the telling.
items.answerEn: It means that a story usually becomes bigger and more exciting each time someone tells it.
items.answerUz: Bu shuni anglatadiki, hikoya har aytilganda kattalashib, qiziqarliroq bo'lib boradi.

items.en: Is there a similar saying in your language?
items.uz: Sizning tilingizda shunga o'xshash maqol bormi?
items.answerEn: Yes. In Uzbek we say that a story grows as it passes from mouth to mouth.

patterns.formula: Was he [fe'l]-ing? - Yes, he was. / No, he wasn't.
patterns.exampleEn: Was he cooking? - No, he wasn't.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ SO'ROQDA 'was' EGADAN OLDIN.
⚠ Qisqa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi.

patterns.formula: What exactly happened? - There was a [voqea].
patterns.exampleEn: What exactly happened yesterday? - There was a robbery in my neighbourhood.
patterns.exampleUz: Kecha aynan nima sodir bo'ldi? - Mahallamizda qaroqchilik bo'ldi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Guvoh ko'rsatuvining birinchi savoli.
⚠ 'There WAS' - o'tgan zamonda 'there is'.

patterns.formula: Where were you at the time? - I was in my [joy].
patterns.exampleEn: Where were you at the time? - I was in my garden.
patterns.exampleUz: O'sha paytda qayerda edingiz? - Bog'imda edim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ HOLAT → past simple ('was/were').
⚠ 'at the time' = o'sha paytda.

patterns.formula: What were you doing? - I was [fe'l]-ing.
patterns.exampleEn: What were you doing? - I was cutting the grass.
patterns.exampleUz: Nima qilayotgan edingiz? - Gazon o'rayotgan edim.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ ISh → past continuous.
⚠ Oldingi qolip bilan SOLIShTIRING: u yerda
HOLAT, bu yerda ISh.

patterns.formula: Fortunately, ... In the end, ... They felt [his-tuyg'u].
patterns.exampleEn: Fortunately, two fishermen helped them. In the end, they felt very relieved.
patterns.exampleUz: Yaxshiyamki, ikki baliqchi ularga yordam berdi. Oxir-oqibat ular o'zlarini juda yengil his qilishdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
⚠ Hikoyani tugatishning qolipi.
⚠ 'Fortunately' + 'In the end' + his-tuyg'u.

groups.ruleUz: ⚠ QO'ShMA OTLAR - JOY VA NARSA NOMLARI
